title: Decision file front matter
description: The front matter of one decision file in docs/design/decisions/. The format is described in README.md beside this file. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share, so a file can be sealed later (#2524 D4).

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: Stable id: a lowercase prefix per epic, a dash and three or more digits. Never reused, never renumbered.

title.description: Short topic, as the source table names it, without revision markers.

area.description: The design section the decision belongs to, such as "D5". Groups the review queue. Null only in an importer draft.

source.description: Where the decision was first recorded: a row of an issue's decisions table, or the workspace itself when no issue holds the decision (#2654).

question.description: One sentence. Null only in an importer draft.

options.description: Every option considered, the chosen one included.

choice.description: The chosen option and why. Null in state proposed or withdrawn.

rejected.description: The options not chosen, kept on the record.

supersedes.description: Earlier choices this decision replaced: another decision file, or an option chosen in an earlier revision of the same design before decision files existed.

evidence.description: The research, audits, design sections and workspace files behind the decision. A public link carries a url; a file in the workspace carries a path and the hash of its bytes (#2549). May be empty when the decision cites nothing; chant workspace records then warns decision-no-evidence (#2654).

decided_by.description: Who chose. A forge login. Null in state proposed or withdrawn.

decided_on.description: When the choice was made, as YYYY-MM-DD. Quoted, so YAML reads it as a string.

reviews.description: Each reviewer's verdict. Empty until a review happens.

digest.description: The digest of the record text the verdict judged: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file with LF line endings and without its reviews block (#2672). A verdict whose digest is not the record's digest now stops counting toward the quorum. A verdict without one still counts, with the warning review-undigested.

session.description: The id of the review session the verdict was given in, as the session names it (#2650 C10). chant workspace records review --session writes it (#2670).

proposes.description: With a dissent, the id of a new proposed decision the reviewer opened.

addressed_by.description: With a dissent, where the decider or the group answered the concern: a decision id, an issue or pull request (owner/repo#n) or an https link. An answer addresses a concern without necessarily accommodating it (RFC 7282, section 3).

withdrawn_on.description: With a dissent, the date its author withdrew the concern. Only the reviewer who raised a concern withdraws it.

then.description: A dissent needs a reason: the dissent by {reviewer} has no note.

else.description: Only a dissent is a concern: the {verdict} by {reviewer} cannot carry addressed_by or withdrawn_on.

constrains.description: What this decision governs: issues (owner/repo#n), other decisions (their ids), workspace members (member:<name>) or files and directories in the workspace (path:<path>, the grammar of an evidence path, #2549). At least one entry: a decision that governs nothing is refused.

workspacePath.description: A path from the workspace root, with / separators: no leading /, no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no backslash and no trailing /.

as_of.description: When the linked text was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Lets a reader flag evidence that changed afterwards.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the linked content, once evidence is pinned by hash (#2555). Null until then.

evidencePin.description: A file in the workspace, pinned by the hash of its bytes (#2524 D18, #2549). chant workspace records reports a file that changed or went missing since.

path.description: The file, from the workspace root. It sits inside a member, such as design/screens/home.json.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes when the decision was written. chant workspace records pin <path> prints it.

as_of.description: When the file was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

sourceIssue.description: A row of the decisions table in an issue.

row.description: The row's topic cell, verbatim, including any revision marker.

revision.description: The design revision that last changed this row, such as "v8". Null when the row carries no marker.

sourceWorkspace.description: A decision made in the workspace, such as in a product's own design flow, with no issue behind it (#2654).

member.description: The workspace member the decision was made in, by its name in the declaration.

session.description: The id of the session the decision was made in, as the member names it. Null or absent when there was none.

issue.description: An issue the decision relates to, when there is one.

label.description: The option as the source table words it, without revision markers.

tradeoff.description: What choosing it costs or gains.

chosen_in.description: The earlier design revision that had chosen this option, when a later revision replaced it.
